## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Maintenance / dependency update

## Verification

- [ ] I ran relevant tests and checks and list their actual results below.
- [ ] I added or updated regression tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated documentation, configuration examples, and changelog where relevant.
- [ ] I checked links and commands introduced by this change.

Checks run:

## Security and architecture

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private keys, customer data, or sensitive logs are included.
- [ ] Authorization is enforced server-side, not only in the dashboard.
- [ ] Tinlance Agent Platform remains authoritative for identity, tenant binding, policy, approvals, governed execution, secrets, and audit.
- [ ] Auctaryn risk assessments are not represented as permission grants.
- [ ] TADL and Agent OS boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Runtime-observation and production-readiness claims are supported by evidence.
- [ ] Operational changes include migration and rollback notes where applicable.

## Compatibility and evidence

Describe API/configuration compatibility, deployment prerequisites, known limitations, and attach real test output or demo evidence where relevant. Do not present mock visuals as proof of a running system.
